description: Rule-based classifier that recursively splits the feature space on the token that best separates classes by impurity (Gini). Produces an interpretable if/then rule structure.
why_tested: End-semester addition; tests whether rule-based nonlinear boundaries capture risky-clause patterns that linear models miss.
input_features: Dense TruncatedSVD (100 components, training-fold fitted) of word unigram/bigram TF-IDF. SVD is required because trees operate poorly on raw high-dimensional sparse text.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/decision_tree/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + svd.joblib + metadata.json). SVD is a transform, saved separately from the model.
